lines.zh: 沙子在我背上滑，我慢慢挪。
lines.en: Sand slides off my back as I shift.

lines.zh: 我大半身子在沙下，只露嘴。
lines.en: Most of me is under the sand, only my mouth showing.

lines.zh: 我爬过沙丘，留一道浅沟。
lines.en: I cross a dune, leaving a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面走，几乎不起尘。
lines.en: I move along the surface, barely raising dust.
The badlands sand is finer than the desert's.

lines.zh: 我的身子太小，沙一盖就没了。
lines.en: I am so small a layer of sand hides me.
I push forward, mouth full of sand.

lines.zh: 我绕开石头，那里藏不住。
lines.en: I avoid the stones; nothing hides there.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在后面拖出一条线。
lines.en: My tail trails a line behind me.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，听沙下的动静。
lines.en: I stop and go, listening under the sand.
I shuffle toward the shade.

lines.zh: 沙粒硌着我的鳞，我不在乎。
lines.en: Sand grits against my scales. I do not mind.
Only a stretch of mouth shows above the sand.

lines.zh: 我在等什么东西踩过来。
lines.en: I wait for something to step close.
My body is almost entirely buried.
The wind blows sand to my mouth.

lines.zh: 我睁着眼，看沙面上的影子。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on shadows on the sand.

lines.zh: 我半张着嘴，等猎物自己送上门。
lines.en: My mouth hangs half open, waiting for prey to come to me.
It is cooler below than above.

lines.zh: 我是这模组里最小的龙。
lines.en: I am the smallest dragon in this mod.
My scales are the colour of sand.
I hear a dog bark far away.
I wait a long time, patiently.

lines.zh: 有一阵风把我埋得更深。
lines.en: A gust buries me a little deeper.
I close my mouth, then open it again.
I hardly need to move at all.

lines.zh: 你这么大，我不打算动你。
lines.en: You are large. I have no plans for you.
I sink a little deeper into the sand.
If you step there you will crush me.
Only my mouth and eyes are out.
Only when you stay away do I raise my head.
I retreat under the sand.

lines.zh: 你手里那根竿子，我吃过亏。
lines.en: That rod in your hand has caught me before.
Do not dig with your hands; I bite.
I shriek. It is an ugly sound.

lines.zh: 你一挡，我这片沙就阴了。
lines.en: You block it, and my patch of sand goes dark.
I am judging whether you are too big.
I will not come near you. Never.
The sand moved. That was me.
Step away and I go back to ambushing.
Looking up at you tires my neck.
Do not follow me.
I shriek and burrow down.

lines.zh: 这一下，我半截身子露出来了。
lines.en: That left half of me exposed.
A few scales were scraped off.
The pain makes my tail whip.

lines.zh: 我的血滴在沙上，很快干了。
lines.en: My blood drips on the sand and dries fast.
I curl up, very small.
My mouth is full of sand and blood.
I try to dig deeper and cannot.
That made me forget the ambush.
Do not step again.

lines.zh: 你递过来的，我一概不碰。
lines.en: Whatever you hold out, I will not touch.
I eat only what is smaller than me.
Try setting it on the ground.
I come close, then withdraw.
Too big. I cannot swallow it.
I do not know this smell.
Your hand moves and I sink.

lines.zh: 我等它自己走到我嘴边。
lines.en: I wait for it to walk to my mouth.
Set the meat on the sand and let me look.
Back off and I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 你的靴子陷进我的埋伏里。
lines.en: Your boot sank into my ambush.

lines.zh: 我被撞得露出半截身子。
lines.en: The bump exposed half of me.
I burrow down at once.
Mind your feet; I am in the sand.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的埋伏白费了。
lines.en: That ruined my ambush.
I shake the sand off my back.
You step back and I sink.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，沙都飞起来。
lines.en: We collide and sand sprays.
I am much smaller. Move aside.
Step again and I bite.
At a time like this I prefer sand.
I am too small. Living is enough.
When kin meet, they bite first.
There is no other of me on this dune.
I do not call; it draws bigger things.
You ask too loudly.

lines.zh: 我连自己的尾巴都藏不好。
lines.en: I cannot even hide my own tail.
The sand covers everything.

lines.zh: 太阳再低些，我才敢出来。
lines.en: Let the sun drop lower before I come out.

lines.zh: 别这么盯着，我浑身不自在。
lines.en: Stop staring like that; it makes my scales crawl.
I catch a scorpion by the tail.
This meat is too small to bother with.

lines.zh: 我用下巴把它按进沙底。
lines.en: I pin it under the sand with my chin.
I drag it once with my teeth.
It fled; I chased half a step.
A bone chip — I keep it for my teeth.
I carry it, and sand gets in my mouth.
This thing moves. Good.
I hide it behind the dune.

lines.zh: 这东西闻着不对，我丢开。
lines.en: This smells wrong; I drop it.
Something walks on the sand.
This size I can swallow.

lines.zh: 我把上下颚撑到不能再开。
lines.en: I stretch my jaws as far as they will go.
It is three steps from my mouth.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底，把身子藏平。
lines.en: I press to the sand and flatten myself.
The sand hides me well.
It has seen me. Too late.
I need one more step from it.

lines.zh: 这个位置正好在影子里。
lines.en: This spot lies right in shadow.
My teeth are already half closed.
It is not a wolf, but it will do.

lines.zh: 沙子盖着我，就等它迈步。
lines.en: The sand covers me; I wait for its step.
It stopped. Bad.
I hold still to let it relax.
I shift along with its shadow.

lines.zh: 它在沙上走，我在沙下走。
lines.en: It walks on the sand; I walk under it.
I make no sound at all.
I wait for it to put its mouth to the water.
It went around my spot.
I bury myself a stretch ahead.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，我抬一次头。
lines.en: Each of its steps, I raise my head once.
Sand gets in my mouth. I endure it.
Its feet are very close now.
A little longer under, until it comes near.

lines.zh: 它的头偏开了，就是现在。
lines.en: Its head has turned away — now.
I draw my tail under the sand.

lines.zh: 它的影子落到沙上，压住我。
lines.en: Its shadow falls on the sand and covers me.

lines.zh: 这一嘴下去，得咬住它的腿根。
lines.en: This bite has to land at the top of its leg.
It steps back; I wait again.

lines.zh: 我一口扣住它最小的脚趾。
lines.en: My jaws clamp on its smallest toe.

lines.zh: 我这一口不深，却足够它跳。
lines.en: My bite is shallow, but enough to make it jump.

lines.zh: 牙齿松开，我一头扎回沙下。
lines.en: I let go and dive straight back under the sand.

lines.zh: 我的牙朝后弯，咬住就不放。
lines.en: My teeth curve backward; once in, they hold.
It shakes its leg and carries me along.
I tumble across the sand.
I shriek and bite again.

lines.zh: 我咬得不深，只是让它记住。
lines.en: I do not bite deep; I only want it to remember.
I got it. It tastes bad.
It stomps; I slip aside.

lines.zh: 我这点力气，你也看见了。
lines.en: You have seen how little force I have.
After the bite I hide under the sand.
I pant, mouth full of sand.
I do not chase. I only wait.
I raise my head from under the sand.
My first breath takes in sand.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身子，沙全滑下去。
lines.en: I shake and the sand slides off.
Only my mouth and eyes show.
Desert. Just right.
I crawl forward an inch.

lines.zh: 风把我身后的痕迹抹平。
lines.en: The wind smooths the trail behind me.
This body is pitifully small.
I open my mouth; my teeth curve back.
The sand is warm. I am comfortable.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋到只剩眼睛。
lines.en: I bury myself until only my eyes show.

lines.zh: 我选了这块背风的地方。
lines.en: I choose this sheltered spot.
I hear footsteps on the sand.
I sink at once.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这里是我的猎场。
lines.en: From today this is my hunting ground.
I wait, motionless.
Fire heats the sand and my scales burn.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘上滚下去，满身是沙。
lines.en: I roll down the dune, covered in sand.

lines.zh: 水渗进沙里，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water soaks the sand and I cannot breathe.

lines.zh: 爆炸把沙掀开，我被抛出去。
lines.en: The blast throws the sand up and me with it.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎穿了我的尾巴。
lines.en: An arrow pins through my tail.

lines.zh: 有力量钻进沙里，找到我。
lines.en: A force slips through the sand and finds me.
Too hungry to open my mouth.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我整条都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sand and I lock up.

lines.zh: 沙子全漏光了，我还在坠。
lines.en: The sand has drained away and I am still falling.
